name: shxray
install:
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/shxray' ] || cd '/agent/repos/shxray' || exit $?
set -euo pipefail

DENO_VERSION=2.9.8
NODE_VERSION=24.22.3

if ! /usr/local/bin/deno --version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | grep -q "deno ${DENO_VERSION}"; then
  curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | DENO_INSTALL="${HOME}/.deno" bash -s -- "v${DENO_VERSION}"
  sudo ln -sfn "${HOME}/.deno/bin/deno" /usr/local/bin/deno
fi

if ! /usr/local/bin/node --version 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "v${NODE_VERSION}"; then
  tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
  tarball="node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz"
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/${tarball}" -o "${tmpdir}/${tarball}"
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/SHASUMS256.txt" -o "${tmpdir}/SHASUMS256.txt"
  (
    cd "${tmpdir}"
    grep "${tarball}" SHASUMS256.txt | sha256sum -c -
  )
  sudo tar -xJf "${tmpdir}/${tarball}" -C /usr/local --strip-components=1
  rm -rf "${tmpdir}"
fi

sudo tee /etc/profile.d/dev-toolchains.sh >/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Prefer the environment Node.js and Deno over older toolchains on PATH.
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"
EOF
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/dev-toolchains.sh

bashrc_line='export PATH="/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"'
if [ -f "${HOME}/.bashrc" ] && ! grep -Fqx "${bashrc_line}" "${HOME}/.bashrc"; then
  printf '\n# Prefer the environment Node.js and Deno.\n%s\n' "${bashrc_line}" >> "${HOME}/.bashrc"
fi

export PATH="/usr/local/bin:${PATH}"

if [ -f deno.json ] && [ -f deno.lock ]; then
  deno cache --frozen src/main.ts tests/unit/analyze_test.ts tests/unit/render_test.ts tests/unit/architecture_test.ts tests/e2e/cli_test.ts tests/e2e/compile_test.ts
fi
